name: Northstar Daypack
description: Your everyday carry, sorted. A compact canvas daypack with a padded laptop sleeve, comfortable straps, and room for a full day of plans.

reviews.author: Maya
reviews.title: My daily go-to
reviews.body: Fits my laptop, lunch, and a book without feeling bulky.

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.title: Ready for the commute
reviews.body: Comfortable straps and useful pockets. I would love one more inside zip pocket.

name: Northstar Transit
description: A streamlined commuter bag for the office, train, and everything between. Thoughtful organization keeps your essentials within reach.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Everything has a place
reviews.body: Makes finding my charger and headphones on the train much easier.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.title: A useful everyday bag
reviews.body: Good organization and a comfortable strap for short trips.

name: Cityline Everyday Tote
description: A roomy tote that goes from the coffee shop to the weekend market. Durable fabric, comfortable handles, and a simple shape that works with everything.

reviews.author: Casey
reviews.title: More room than it looks
reviews.body: My favorite for a notebook, water bottle, and a few market finds.

reviews.author: Riley
reviews.title: Easy to carry
reviews.body: Lightweight and useful for a day around town.

name: Roam Weekender
description: Pack a little adventure. A versatile weekend bag with space for a change of clothes, travel essentials, and the things you never leave behind.

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.title: Perfect for two nights away
reviews.body: Everything fits and the wide opening makes packing simple.

reviews.author: Morgan
reviews.title: Weekend staple
reviews.body: Easy to grab and go, with enough room for an extra layer.
